_about: Rack fit by TILE SIZE (Tiffany Oct 26 7:37/7:39pm). tw = tile WIDTH in inches (what sets rack length: ~19 tiles stand side by side). Rule: a rack of 18.5" or less (len<=18.5) is offered only with sets whose tw<=0.95 (OMM-size 0.87, MRC 0.91, Bam Bird 0.9, Virora 0.9, YMI 0.91, Mahjong Studios 0.94 = standard). Sets with 1"+ tiles (Sunday, PLM, MFM, Mahj Mood, Amahj, Bespoke, Miss Mahjong, M&M, B&B, Mac+Miller, LMO, Charleston, YOLO, Mahj Squad: "large tiles require racks at least 19 inches") get 19"+ racks only. Unknown width = treated as large (safe). 20" = her recommended standard ("fits most tiles"). Researched Nov 1 from each brand product page (/products/<handle>.json); src says where.
